text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap called me out, saying, "I want 
to train my cardiovascular endurance for 
the race," but—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
According to Tama and Inari, roller 
coasters are apparently optimal for 
training.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"If I ride a roller coaster, my heart 
should grow even stronger."

Harboring a slight sense of unease, I 
decided to accompany Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Such intense shaking... that 
weightlessness, the speed, the raw force. 
At this rate, more than just my heart 
will—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Where is this...? I was supposed to be on 
a roller coaster...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Are those the Three Goddesses I see 
over there? It looks like they're dancing 
the Bon Odori, though."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Are you saying that dancing the Bon 
Odori will make me stronger?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I can't afford to fall behind either.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see... Drifting smoothly to break out of 
the pack, spinning around and accelerating 
through the corner...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"She who masters the Bon Odori masters the 
race," huh? Well said, Three Goddesses...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
choice_data_list: Did you zone out for a second?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
In a mysterious grassy meadow, the Three 
Goddesses were dancing the Bon Odori...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So I danced right back, refusing to be 
outdone.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I feel power surging through my entire 
body. ...I must have gotten stronger.

Oguri Cap smiled proudly, looking a size 
or two larger than ever before.
